title: Finish Ultimate Plus X 297 Lemon Dishwasher Tablets $85.83 ($80.78 eBay Plus) Delivered @ GoodPricePeople eBay
body:
Deal: Finish Ultimate Plus X 297 Lemon Dishwasher Tablets $85.83 ($80.78 eBay Plus) Delivered @ GoodPricePeople eBay

[Poison Ivy] waiting for someone in the comments to tell me if this is good
[Lizard Spock] Aldi can't hear you right now, we had to pack his ears with gauze.
[Stewardo] 27c each is a good price for these.
Coles is selling them for $1.20 per tablet.
[EBC] Good price but Aldi Logix platinum is ~24c per tablet all the time. I've never noticed a difference in cleaning power or residue.
[John K] Finish Ultimate Plus performs well in our Bosch dishwasher. Tried Aldi ones and they didn't perform as well.
[CommanderCrumbcake] Appreciate you taking the time out of your busy day for such an insightful comment. Hats off to you
[Oisinmc95] Tried these before, they leave a very strong odour of lemon that is noticeable when using glassware etc after washing
[Jimothy Wongingtons] Weird I use these and can’t really detect any smell left over
[Oisinmc95] That's good, I guess it depends on the water too and how it reacts to the cleaning process
[krazynayba] I've noticed this too, but also with pretty much every scented one. For me it's anything plastic or silicone that cops it.
We tend to use the unscented ecostore ones and use these every second or third load for a more intense clean (leaving any plastic or silicone out)
IMO perfumes are completely unnecessary and I hate them.
[Sleepycat3] It depends on how the dishwasher runs its final rinse cycle. Some don't do a final rinse after the rinse, so you get that smell. My Miele does a final rinse, so there is only a minimal odour when I used these tablets.
[hybir] The same seller also sells Finish 0% for a similar price if you're sensitive to the odour.
[cyrax83] I think Aldi is about 25c per tablet. This is about 27c so still a little more.
[starbearer] would've been all over this if I didnt still have more than half of the haul when catch.com.au shut down
[Tock] Should get you through nearly 3 years if you run your washer twice a week like we do.
[mstrelan] We run ours at least twice a day, often three times. And yes it is mostly always full. Family of 5. Most pots and pans go in the dishwasher.
[Pulseless] honestly just get aldi powder - dont waste money on tablets
[EyyBanane] Aldi Logix is the best. After my stack from CoTD finished recently, switched over and can visible difference in the cleaning quality.
[pastapins] Exactly in the same boat. The stashfrom CoTD just finished and was wondering what next. Will try Aldi Platinum.
[4agte] There is always these as well https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/972760
[ilikedeals] Many comments about residue left-over/dishwashing product taste on clean dishes
[Elias11] The residue is a chemical which contaminates onto your food. It should be odourless at the end.
